en.headline: Good Hope School principal apologises over Cantonese ban wording in graduation video guidelines
en.dek: Dr Gary Harfitt said an unedited internal slide containing the phrase “Cantonese is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN” was sent in error and does not reflect school policy.
body: The principal of Good Hope School in Ngau Chi Wan has apologised after internal guidelines for Secondary 6 graduation videos stating that Cantonese was “STRICTLY FORBIDDEN” circulated online and drew public criticism.

In a late-night email to students and parents, principal Dr Gary Harfitt said an unedited presentation slide containing inappropriate wording had been sent to the Form 6 cohort. He accepted full responsibility and emphasised that the content did not represent school policy or the actual arrangements for the graduation ceremony.

Harfitt stated that the school has never banned the use of Cantonese. While the Direct Subsidy Scheme girls’ school takes pride in its English-medium instruction, he said Cantonese and Putonghua are equally valued. Many past graduates have used Cantonese when saying farewell to teachers and classmates at the Secondary 6 event, which is conducted mainly in English.

The circulated document required all dialogue, narration and voice-overs to be in English or Putonghua (with English subtitles for the latter), and stated that any audio containing Cantonese would have to be muted and reworked. It also specified that thanks to Chinese-subject teachers must be delivered in Putonghua.
Harfitt said he would meet Form 6 students in person next week to address the matter. The Education Bureau has been approached for comment.

zh.headline: 德望學校校長就畢業影片「禁用粵語」指引致歉
zh.dek: 校長Harfitt指未修訂簡報誤發予中六生，強調內容不符校方政策，校方從未禁止使用粵語。
body: 九龍清水灣道德望學校校長就網上流傳中六畢業影片語言指引出現「Cantonese is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN」（嚴格禁止粵語）字眼一事致歉。
校長Dr Gary Harfitt深夜向學生及家長發電郵，指一份未經修訂、含有不恰當措辭的簡報投影片「遺憾地」發送給中六同學。他表示會承擔全部責任，並強調有關內容既不反映學校政策及實際情況，亦非畢業典禮的真實安排。
Harfitt強調，校方絕無禁止使用粵語。雖然學校以英文作為主要教學語言為榮，但同樣充分肯定粵語與普通話的重要性。過往許多畢業生在中六告別禮上向師長及同學道別時，都會使用粵語。
流傳的文件要求所有對白、旁白及配音必須以英語錄製，或以普通話錄製並配上英文字幕；若音軌發現粵語，相關班別須將該段靜音並重新製作。向中文科教師致謝時亦須使用普通話。
校長表示，下周會親自向中六同學當面交代事件。教育局正被查詢有關情況。
